title: Circulation paths within employee work areas.
officialText:
Common use circulation paths within employee work areas shall be
accessible routes.
Exceptions: The following exceptions apply only to the common use circulation paths within an employee work area and are not
intended to remove the requirement of Section 1103.2.3 that employee work areas be designed and constructed so that individuals
with disabilities can approach, enter and exit the employee work area.
1. Common use circulation paths, located within employee work areas less than 300 square feet (27.9 m2) in size, and defined
by permanently installed partitions, counters, casework or furnishings not serving accessible employee work stations that
are required in Section 1103.2.3.1, shall not be required to be accessible routes.
2. Common use circulation paths, located within employee work areas, that are an integral component of equipment, shall not
be required to be accessible routes.
